name: Dahlquist 2D
note: Two-dimensional Dahlquist test problem x=a*x+b*y, y=c*x+d*y. THE system of the Order tab stability-region mode: a, b, c, d are NOT typed in, they are recomputed in every grid node from (sigma, omega) and the asymmetry k and ratio r, so that the matrix eigenvalues are exactly sigma +- i*omega. Any scheme, including a custom KRS, is analysed by feeding it this very system; a custom KRS written for it must address a[1..4] as a, b, c, d. Stability regions are computed for this system only - the values stored below are just a sane starting point for the other tabs.
plain_text:
x' = a*x + b*y \\
y' = c*x + d*y
